Core finding: H1's mechanism (5-bar-window local-low pivot + breakout-of-high trigger) is the same information source as the already-killed `anticipate` (holdout R/trade -0.508) and `bos` (-0.607) families in tournament.mjs/backtest.js - same isLeftLow/detectSwings n=5 pivot primitive, differing only in price field (close vs low) and confirmation timing, which is a parameter tweak not a new information source. sweep_reclaim/range_sweep_reclaim/h3 are the same rolling-low+reclaim category with different N, also already killed. This directly violates TOURNAMENT_ROADMAP.md's own 'Honest Assessment' constraint that a rebuild must use a genuinely different information source, not another OHLCV price-structure variant. Additional integrity risks flagged independently by the structural reviewer, worth remembering if a similar proposal appears again: (1) gating on GROSS Sharpe/win-rate before applying costs risks laundering an already-net-negative signal into an apparent 'pass' under a different metric - Phase 1 should never be treated as validation, only as a diagnostic, exactly like TOURNAMENT_ROADMAP.md's own Track 1; (2) 3 correlated large-caps (BTC/ETH/SOL) with no per-asset dispersion gate is a real generalization risk, not a neutral narrowing - this repo's own standard is >=50% of the FULL watchlist (20 pairs per ROADMAP.md), not 2-of-3 correlated majors; (3) n>=60 is a TRAIN-only floor with no holdout-n minimum, which for a ~2yr daily-bar holdout window likely implies ~40-55 holdout trades - well under this repo's established ~150-200 reliability floor; (4) the roadmap never states what happens if H1 PASSES (only the fail branch is written), which is exactly the kind of ambiguous state AGENT_PROTOCOL.md treats as a hard stop, not something to infer at runtime. ONE genuinely open, real gap (not fabricated): tournament.mjs:38 hardcodes entryTf:"1h" for every family - no family, including anticipate/bos, has ever actually been tested on 1d. This is the only legitimate unexplored variable in v2. RECOMMENDED FOLLOW-UP (STAGED 2026-08-07 as T6-TIMEFRAME-ISOLATION, see work_queue - this paragraph's own text is what the item's task field quotes): a narrow, explicitly-labeled REPLICATION test of anticipate/bos on 1d only - net-of-cost from the start (no gross-first phase), full watchlist (not 3 assets), the existing R/trade-sign-both-windows gate (not a new Sharpe/win-rate metric), proper holdout-n floor (>=150 per this repo's standard). Frame it as 'does 1d change the anticipate/bos verdict', not as a fresh H1 under a new roadmap label - and if it also fails, that closes the swing-low/pivot-reclaim signal family across both tested timeframes, which is a genuinely stronger, more complete verdict than either timeframe alone.

template_a_exhausted.finding: THE GATE-SWAP EXPERIMENT IS EXHAUSTED. Do not stage another one. 'Template A' means: take a time series, fix a threshold on train, apply it as a suppression/confirmation gate on breakout/anticipate, score holdout avgR. It has been run 11 times with different inputs (funding, open interest, liquidations, futures basis, long/short ratio, top traders, aggressor flow, realized vol, trend quality, on-chain flow, seasonality). Every one failed.
template_a_exhausted.measured: Mean effect of applying a gate, across the studies that quoted comparable numbers: -0.008 R. Required to reach breakeven from the current -0.864 R breakout baseline: +0.864 R. The largest positive delta on record is +0.295 R, and it is the best CELL of a descriptive breakdown selected after seeing results, so it is a selection artifact rather than an effect. The 12th input series has near-zero expected information: eleven runs have pinned the null.
template_a_exhausted.where_the_effect_actually_is: The single largest measured change in this project's history came from the cost side, not the signal side: the fee-schedule rebase moved the breakout baseline from -0.445 (at ~0.9% round-trip) to -0.864 (at the corrected ~1.7%), a 0.419 R shift - larger than every gate effect ever measured, combined. Cost and execution is the only axis where this project has ever observed an effect big enough to matter. Direct new research there.
template_a_exhausted.also: Each additional Template A run also adds a comparison to a family already carrying roughly a 51% family-wise false-positive probability. See MULTIPLE-COMPARISONS-AUDIT.
